meta.name: to-tickets
meta.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker (edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解方案或讨论为带依赖的任务单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常把方案或讨论纪要变成任务清单
copy.tagline_en: Turn plans and specs into dependency-aware tickets automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn plans or specs into actionable task lists.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把计划、规格或当前对话拆成一组 tracer-bullet 工单——贯穿各层的垂直切片,每个工单标出阻塞它的其他工单,再按配置的跟踪器发布:本地每个工单一个文件,真实跟踪器则用原生阻塞链接。
howto.when: 当你想把一份计划、规格或当前对话拆成工单并发布时使用;需先用 /setup-matt-pocock-skills 配置好跟踪器与标签词汇。

say.text: 把这份计划拆成工单,发布到跟踪器
say.note: 会先给出编号拆解清单等你确认

say.text: 把当前对话拆成垂直切片的工单
say.note: 每个工单会标出阻塞它的工单

say.text: 这个拆解的粒度和阻塞关系对吗?
say.note: 它会逐条调整到你认可

howto.what_en: Claude breaks a plan, spec, or the conversation into tracer-bullet tickets — vertical slices through every layer — each listing what blocks it, then publishes them to the configured tracker (local files or native blocking links).
howto.when_en: Use when you want a plan, spec, or the current conversation turned into tickets; the tracker and triage labels must first be set up with /setup-matt-pocock-skills.

say_en.text: Turn this plan into tickets and publish them to the tracker
say_en.note: It lists the breakdown first for your review

say_en.text: Break this conversation into vertical-slice tickets
say_en.note: Each ticket lists what blocks it

say_en.text: Is the granularity and blocking right?
